duplicate_conflict_rule.applies_to: two or more rows of the authoritative source sharing one identity_fields triple but carrying different impact labels
duplicate_conflict_rule.rule: the highest impact_rank wins; the losing labels are recorded on the collapsed row and counted in the run self-report
duplicate_conflict_rule.rationale: A news filter is a safety device. On an identity conflict the fail-safe direction is the more restrictive classification, never the milder one: blocking a window that did not need blocking costs one skipped trade, trading through a window that should have been blocked costs an unbounded tail. Contract section 8 explicitly permits visible deduplication under a recorded rule, so the escalation is logged rather than silent.
duplicate_conflict_rule.unresolvable: two different labels of equal rank remain a hard DuplicateEventConflict - there is no fail-safe direction to pick
